project: How2Soap — FF-Style Top-Down Mining & Building Strategy

mission.stated: Emergent chemistry & survival engine — make soap from scratch. Zero runtime deps. PWA offline. 5-tier tech progression. Deterministic 10 Hz Web Worker sim + 67,648-byte SAB SeqLock @ 60 FPS.
mission.actual: 2D-canvas dominant with small WebGL preview pane (LabBench3DCanvas). 6,862 LOC across engine/app/ui. 194 passing tests. <200 KiB entrypoint. 2D astrolabe strategy map.
mission.gap: FF/Civ mining strategy requires 3D isometric rendering at 50-60° pitch, Blender-authored PBR assets, Civ-style district/quarter construction UI, colony labor economy feeding that UI. None exist yet — genre conversion, not refactor.

optimality.algorithm: Existing sim solid — Seqlock + SAB + Web Worker @ 10 Hz correct. No O(n²) in core paths. desire-path 32×32 grid = 1,024 bytes, trivial.
optimality.complexity: Colony Boids n×n but n capped by tavern recruitment economics. No change needed.
optimality.resources: Zero-deps invariant will break if Three.js added. Options: (1) Blender→sprites→Canvas2D keeps AGENTS.md, (2) Three.js breaks AGENTS.md but full 3D, (3) Hybrid custom WebGL / lazy Three.js keeps main <200 KiB.
alternatives: Option 1: Blender → sprites → Canvas2D (keeps zero-deps, loses dynamic lighting)
Option 2: Blender → glTF → Three.js (full 3D, breaks zero-deps)
Option 3: Hybrid (custom WebGL / lazy Three.js) — recommended
optimality.scalability: SAB 67,648 B + worker @ 10 Hz scales to 10× colonists / 10× biome nodes. Rendering: 150k tris / 200 draw calls @ 60 fps comfortable with InstancedMesh.

recommendations.title: Amend AGENTS.md §1 — zero-deps for core sim, three in lazy chunk
recommendations.why: Three.js is needed for glTF 2.0 loading and 3D FF/Civ visuals. Current §1 forbids runtime deps.
recommendations.what: Change §1 to: 'Zero runtime deps for core sim; three isolated in lazy view chunk (dynamic import).'
recommendations.interactiveControl: CI gate: verify main entrypoint still <200 KiB after change
recommendations.acceptance: npx tsc --noEmit passes; npm run build entrypoint <200 KiB; three in separate chunk

recommendations.title: Blender asset pipeline — 6 initial glTF assets via Khronos Validator
recommendations.why: FF-style mining game needs Blender-authored PBR assets. Validator ensures Tier-1 glTF 2.0 compliance.
recommendations.what: Author grass-tile, tree, rock, house, mine-shaft, colonist glTF in Blender 3.6/4.2 LTS; export binary .glb with Draco (terrain) / no Draco (props); validate with Khronos Validator.
recommendations.interactiveControl: Blender MCP get_scene_info + screenshot verification per asset
recommendations.acceptance: All 6 .glb pass Khronos Validator; renderer.info tri counts match budgets; 60 fps for 100-instance scene

recommendations.title: Civ VII District/Quarter construction UI with adjacency arrows
recommendations.why: Core strategy loop from Civ VII: place District → slot 2 Buildings = Quarter. UI shows adjacency bonuses, overbuilding penalties, specialist slots.
recommendations.what: Left build panel/contextual menu + top resource bar + placement mode with predicted-yield delta arrows. WorkerCommands: PLACE_DISTRICT, SLOT_BUILDING, BUILD_WONDER, RESEARCH, DESIGNATE_MINE, SET_BILL.
recommendations.endpoint: WorkerCommand: { type: 'PLACE_DISTRICT', district: 'MINE', tile: {x,y} }; { type: 'SLOT_BUILDING', quarterId, slot, building }; { type: 'BUILD_WONDER', wonder: 'GRAND_SMELTER', tile }
recommendations.interactiveControl: Left panel hover updates yields; 'place me here' ghost; green/red delta arrows; yield overlay toggle #btn-yield-overlay
recommendations.acceptance: Build District → Quarter flow works end-to-end (place Mine → slot Smelter + Hauler → Quarter yields recalc); adjacency arrows correct; tech tree unlocks gate recipes

recommendations.title: FF 2.5D camera: 50–60° pitch, 35–50mm FOV, tilt-shift DoF, bloom
recommendations.why: FF Pixel Remaster / Crystal Chronicles use 50–60° pitch diorama (not 90° top-down). Dynamic camera breaks HD-2D illusion.
recommendations.what: Three.js OrbitControls (rotate/zoom, no 90° top-down); 1× warm Sun + Sky Texture ambient + emissive torch points + AgX/Bloom (UnrealBloomPass); tilt-shift DoF top/bottom. Gate bloom behind prefers-reduced-motion.
recommendations.endpoint: Three.js PerspectiveCamera (50° pitch, 40mm) + EffectComposer + UnrealBloomPass + BokehPass (DoF)
recommendations.interactiveControl: Settings toggle for bloom/DoF; prefers-reduced-motion disables both; WCAG 2.3.1 photosensitivity guard (no flash >3×/s)
recommendations.acceptance: 60 fps @ ≤150k tris / ≤200 draw calls; reduced-motion disables DoF/bloom; keyboard nav preserved
recommendations.source: Tier 2: 80.lv Crystal Chronicles interview (Toshiyuki Itahana) + Digital Foundry tilt-shift breakdown

recommendations.title: 3D colony labor: InstancedMesh + desire-path wear + RimWorld work tab
recommendations.why: Colony is the gameplay heart. Desire paths (+20% speed on worn trails) + Boids steering + wage/morale system must render in 3D without killing fps.
recommendations.what: InstancedMesh for colonists (1 draw call/100 workers); 4-bone rigs; 32×32 wear grid → darkened path decal overlay; RimWorld F1 Work tab (1–4 priorities); click-drag Mine rectangle designator.
recommendations.endpoint: WorkerCommand: { type: 'DESIGNATE_MINE', rect: {x0,y0,x1,y1} }; F1 priorities grid (colonists×work-types, 1–4)
recommendations.interactiveControl: Colonist cards bottom HUD (click select, right-click manual order); Mine/Haul/Cut/Hunt designators; Bills tab repeat crafting
recommendations.acceptance: 50 colonists pathing @ 60 fps; desire-path wear renders; mine-drag works; wage/strike triggers via COLONY_SYNC

recommendations.title: Render performance guard: ≤150k tris / ≤200 draw calls + LOD chain
recommendations.why: Draw calls dominate web fps. Without instancing/material sharing, 3D scene craters.
recommendations.what: Polygon budgets per asset (terrain 100–500 tris, building 300–1,500, hero 1,500–4,000, character 800–3,000); InstancedMesh for trees/rocks/units; THREE.LOD for buildings; texture atlas 512²–1024²; Draco for terrain, none for small props.
recommendations.interactiveControl: Dev overlay: renderer.info (tris + draw calls) visible in dev mode
recommendations.acceptance: 60 fps with 100 colonists + 30 buildings + 500 props; dev overlay reports within budget
recommendations.source: Tier 1: Khronos glTF 2.0 spec + Three.js InstancedMesh/LOD docs

recommendations.title: Khronos glTF Validator in CI for all .glb assets
recommendations.why: Every Blender export must pass Tier-1 glTF 2.0 validation before merge.
recommendations.what: Add CI step: Khronos glTF Validator over public/assets/**/*.glb; fail build on errors.
recommendations.interactiveControl: CI badge turns red on validation failure with validator log output
recommendations.acceptance: CI passes on current assets; fails on intentionally broken glTF

recommendations.title: Blender MCP pipeline scripts (Node Wrangler, Normals, Principled)
recommendations.why: Blender manual confirms glTF exporter needs single Principled BSDF per material; Node Wrangler auto-wires PBR.
recommendations.what: Create blender/export_glb.py (apply modifiers, apply scale, JPEG images, Draco/mehsOpt); blender/setup_pbr.py (Node Wrangler: Principled Texture Setup from filenames)
recommendations.interactiveControl: Script logs conformance: applied modifiers ✓, applied scale ✓, images JPEG ✓, KHR_materials_unlit for flat props ✓
recommendations.acceptance: Script produces .glb that passes Khronos Validator first try
